design.name: gemm_bias_relu_npu
design.description: Parameterized int8 GEMM with int32 bias add and ReLU activation, using tiled accumulation and streaming ready/valid interfaces.

operations.name: op_gemm_core
operations.semantics: For each output element C[m,n], compute acc[m,n]=sum_{k=0..K-1}(A[m,k]*B[k,n]) with signed int8 multiplicands and signed int32 accumulation.

operations.name: op_bias_add
operations.semantics: For each output element, add signed int32 bias per output column: z[m,n]=acc[m,n]+bias[n].

operations.name: op_relu
operations.semantics: For each output element, y[m,n]=max(0,z[m,n]) in signed int32 domain.

data_types.name: dt_int8
data_types.conversion_semantics: Sign-extend when promoted to multiplier input internal width.
data_types.overflow_semantics: Wrap on any explicit truncation (none in mandatory path).

data_types.name: dt_int32
data_types.overflow_semantics: Wrap on add/multiply-accumulate overflow in 32-bit accumulator.

dimensions.name: dim_n
dimensions.semantic: Output cols / B cols / bias length

dimensions.name: dim_k
dimensions.semantic: Reduction dimension / A cols / B rows

parameters.name: TILE_M
parameters.description: Row tile size for compute engine.

parameters.name: TILE_N
parameters.description: Column tile size for compute engine.

compute.organization: Single-core tiled GEMM engine with local scratchpads and MAC grid sized TILE_M x TILE_N (time-multiplexed across K).
compute.dataflow: Output-stationary within tile; accumulators retained locally across full K sweep.
compute.parallelism: Up to TILE_M*TILE_N parallel MACs per cycle when A-row vector and B-col vector are available.
compute.scheduling: Phase order per job: load config -> load bias -> tiled loops over (m_tile,n_tile): zero acc, for k in K load A/B slices and MAC, then bias+ReLU, then stream out tile.

storage.name: buf_a_tile
storage.access_pattern: Read TILE_M int8 values per K step, refill each K step.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write vector port from ingress staging, 1 read vector port to MAC.
storage.implementation_hint: Register file or small SRAM with banking by row.
storage.reuse_semantics: Reused across all n_tile for current m_tile and k step only if scheduled preload retained for cycle; otherwise reloaded per step.
storage.lifetime: One K step within active tile computation.

storage.name: buf_b_tile
storage.access_pattern: Read TILE_N int8 values per K step, refill each K step.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write vector port from ingress staging, 1 read vector port to MAC.
storage.implementation_hint: Register file or small SRAM with banking by column.
storage.reuse_semantics: Reused across all m_tile for current n_tile and k step only if retained in schedule; baseline reload each step.
storage.lifetime: One K step within active tile computation.

storage.name: buf_bias_full
storage.access_pattern: Sequential load once per job; random/strided read by n index during output finalize.
storage.port_requirements: 1 write port ingress, 1 read port finalize stage.
storage.implementation_hint: Single-port SRAM acceptable with time-separated read/write phases.
storage.reuse_semantics: Loaded once per job and reused for every output row.

storage.name: buf_acc_tile
storage.access_pattern: Initialize to zero, read-modify-write each K step, read once at finalize.
storage.port_requirements: At least TILE_M*TILE_N accumulator registers or equivalent multiport/banked storage to sustain parallel MAC updates.
storage.reuse_semantics: Holds partial sums across full K loop for one output tile.
storage.lifetime: From tile start until tile output emission.

pipeline.responsibility: Accept config and stream payload words into loaders/scratchpads.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Holds internal write enables low; no state advance without transfer.

pipeline.responsibility: Perform tiled MAC accumulation into acc tile buffer.
pipeline.valid_behavior: Advances k/tile counters only when operand slices available and compute_enable true.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Freezes counters and accumulator write indices; accumulator contents unchanged.

pipeline.responsibility: Add bias and apply ReLU for each tile element.
pipeline.valid_behavior: Produces finalized int32 elements with tile order metadata.
pipeline.stall_behavior: Retains pending finalized element until downstream ready.
Keeps out_valid asserted and payload stable while waiting.

control.strategy: Central FSM with nested counters for phase and dimensions.
control.error_behavior: If runtime M/N/K is 0 or exceeds MAX_* or protocol order invalid, raise error flag and enter ERROR state; ignore payload transfers except status reads.

reset.required_state: FSM to IDLE, valid flags deasserted, counters zeroed, error flag cleared, no requirement to clear data SRAM contents.

architecture_contract.latency_model: Variable latency: L = config_load + bias_load(N) + sum_tiles( K*(load_step+mac_step) + finalize_step + output_step ) with backpressure-dependent extension.
architectural_invariants: Computation is exact integer sequence: GEMM then bias add then ReLU.
Bias is applied once per output element after full K accumulation.
Output ordering is row-major over M then N.
No output transfer occurs before corresponding full accumulation and finalize complete.
open_assumptions: Single input stream is packetized with explicit section tags for config, bias, A, B.
A and B payload are provided in compute-consumption order required by scheduler (no global full-matrix storage required).
Accumulator overflow uses two's-complement wrap as no saturation requirement was specified.
Error recovery is reset-only because no explicit clear command was requested.

channels.name: cmd_data_in
channels.framing: Packetized sections in strict order: config(1 beat) -> bias(dim_n beats) -> repeated A/B compute payload beats.
channels.backpressure: Source obeys in_ready; transfer only on in_valid&&in_ready.

channels.name: result_out
channels.framing: dim_m*dim_n beats per job, last asserted on final beat.
channels.backpressure: Sink drives out_ready; module holds stable payload when stalled.

signals.name: in_data
signals.semantic: Input payload word; int8/int32 fields packed by section format

signals.name: in_last
signals.semantic: Last beat of current logical section

global_handshake_rules.transfer_condition: A channel transfer occurs iff ready && valid.
global_handshake_rules.stall_behavior: While valid=1 and ready=0, payload and metadata remain stable; internal state tied to that channel transfer does not advance.

modules.name: gemm_bias_relu_npu_top
modules.responsibility: Top integration of interfaces, control, buffers, compute, and output.

modules.name: control_fsm
modules.responsibility: Phase/state control and loop counters, error handling.

modules.name: input_loader
modules.responsibility: Decode input sections and populate config/bias/operand staging buffers.

modules.name: mac_tile_engine
modules.responsibility: Perform int8xint8 MAC accumulation into int32 tile accumulators.

modules.name: bias_relu_unit
modules.responsibility: Apply bias addition and ReLU to accumulated tile values.

modules.name: output_streamer
modules.responsibility: Serialize finalized tile/output matrix to result interface with ordering/last generation.

functional: Given legal M,N,K and ordered payload, output equals software reference: Y=ReLU(AxB + bias) with signed int8 inputs and signed int32 accumulation/output.
Output stream emits exactly M*N elements in row-major order with out_last asserted only on final element.
Bias value bias[n] is applied to every row m for column n exactly once after full K reduction.
verification: Minimum 100 randomized legal transactions varying M,N,K within bounds and randomized backpressure on input/output ready signals.
Reset test required: asserting rst_n low returns interface/control to idle deterministic state and clears done/error.
Backpressure test required: when out_valid=1 and out_ready=0 for arbitrary bursts, out_data/out_last stay stable and no duplication/loss occurs.
Boundary tests include M,N,K at 1 and at MAX_M,MAX_N,MAX_K plus non-multiples of TILE_M/TILE_N.
rtl: RTL must be synthesizable SystemVerilog and avoid forbidden constructs: real, shortreal, delay statements, force/release, classes.
No behavioral dependency on unsynthesizable initialization; control correctness must rely on reset-defined state.
synopsys_handoff: Synthesis/timing/power/area/frequency/utilization claims are accepted only from deterministic Synopsys tool reports matching project schema.
No estimated or inferred PPA metrics allowed without authoritative deterministic report.
Handoff includes verified RTL evidence before Synopsys result publication.
